title: Content Strategist – PR and Media Relations Lead
Sourcing Execution-Leader
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Summary:**
 We are seeking an accomplished sourcing execution leader to lead long\-term sourcing initiatives, supplier consolidation, and localization programs to optimize supply chain. This role is pivotal in driving deflation/PPV, operational efficiency, reducing complexity, and ensuring alignment with long\-term business objectives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate
 **must have a strong background in commodity sourcing (Machining/Fabrication/Casting/Engineering Systems \& Forging), supplier capability development \& risk mitigation** 
 , with a proven track record of driving supplier development, simplification of supply chain, total cost of value chain and supply base rationalization and localization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Commodity Management \& Strategic Sourcing Execution: (Casting, Machining, Fabrication, Engineering Systems \& Forging) management
* Executing sourcing strategies for Casting, Machining, Fabrication, Engineering Systems, and Forging components.
* Achieve annual cost deflation targets through negotiations, value engineering, and alternate sourcing.
* Collaborate with engineering and suppliers for timely development of new parts.
* Ensure localization initiatives to reduce dependency on imports and optimize lead times.
* Assess and improve supplier capacity to meet current and future demand.
* Implement capacity\-building programs and monitor progress against agreed timelines.
* Conduct regular supplier audits covering quality, delivery, and compliance.
* Maintain supplier scorecards and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard new suppliers to strengthen the supply chain.
* Ensure risk mitigation by developing alternate sources for critical components.
* Track and report KPIs such as cost deflation, part development timelines, supplier capacity utilization, and supplier performance metrics.
* Use data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and strategic planning.
* Collaborate with Central Sourcing team to escalate \& resolve the issues related to preferred suppliers.
* Build and manage a regional supplier base to enhance localization, reduce lead times, and improve logistics responsiveness. Key topics will include rubber localisation, existing C class purchase from global inter\-company entities.
* Lead supplier capability assessments including capacity, quality systems, and risk profiles.
* Responsible and accountable for signing long term frame agreement with supplier
* Responsible and accountable for simplifying supplier landscape through supplier reduction, consolidation, signing long term frame agreement with supplier
* Responsible for supplier QBR ( quarterly business review) calendar and action closures
* Lead transformation of supplier capabilities – reduce subcontracting activities
* Responsible for make\-buy decision
* Long\-Term Strategic Initiatives:
* Drive supplier consolidation to streamline operations and reduce supply chain complexity.
* Lead initiatives to reduce Supplier Lead Time (LT) and Minimum Order Quantities (MOQs), improving agility and inventory management.
* Implement Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs to optimize stock levels and enhance service levels.
* Responsible and accountable for supplier capacity assessments to ensure capability alignment with long\-term volume requirements.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
* Serve as the primary interface with Central Purchasing and Supplier Quality teams to align on OTD, quality, and performance improvement plans.
* Support internal stakeholders across Operations, Quality, Engineering, and Finance through transparent communication and results\-driven execution.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, or related field; MBA preferred.
* 15–22 years of experience in sourcing and end\-to\-end supply chain management.
* Proven track record in sourcing, localization, and supplier development programs.
* Expertise in supplier negotiation, capacity planning, inventory optimization, VMI, and risk management.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and strong data analytics skills.
* Experience working in a matrix organization with US or European companies


**Key Competencies:**
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to align sourcing strategies with long\-term business objectives.
* Influencing \& Negotiation: Strong capability to manage supplier relationships and drive favorable outcomes.
* Change Leadership: Lead transformation initiatives and manage resistance effectively.
* Collaboration: Foster cross\-functional teamwork and global alignment.
* Decision Making: Make data\-driven decisions under uncertainty and pressure.


**Additional Information**
**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**
 At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.
   

  

 Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.
   

  

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**
 We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.
   

  

 Need accommodation? Just let us know \- we’ve got you.
